field.name: fr_directory_line_id
field.invisible: fr_directory_company_entity_type != 'private' or fr_directory_partner_entity_type not in ('public', 'private') or move_type not in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund')
field.required: fr_directory_company_entity_type == 'private' and fr_directory_partner_entity_type in ('public', 'private') and move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund')

button.name: %(fr_einvoicing_send_action)d
button.invisible: fr_directory_company_entity_type != 'private' or fr_directory_partner_entity_type not in ('public', 'private') or state != 'posted' or move_type not in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund') or fr_einvoicing_flow_id

button.name: %(fr_einvoicing_event_manual_action)d
button.invisible: fr_directory_company_entity_type != 'private' or fr_directory_partner_entity_type not in ('public', 'private') or not fr_einvoicing_flow_id

page.name: fr-einvoicing
page.invisible: fr_directory_company_entity_type != 'private' or fr_directory_partner_entity_type not in ('public', 'private') or (state == 'draft' and move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund'))

field.name: fr_directory_line_id
field.invisible: fr_directory_company_entity_type != 'private' or fr_directory_partner_entity_type not in ('public', 'private') or move_type not in ('in_invoice', 'in_refund')
